title: Recursive language models
summary: A recursive language model stores an input 30 times longer than its context window in a Python variable, then writes code to inspect it and make sub-model calls on selected pieces. Six figures show the loop, results on four tasks, and its limits using numbers from the paper.

source.label: Zhang, Kraska and Khattab, “Recursive Language Models”, arXiv:2512.24601v2, 2026
